rationale: The description details digital-experience analytics that tracks and captures interactions, then presents analysis as scores, visualizations, and recommendations for digital improvement.
evidence_spans:
Digital experience analytics platform that enables businesses to track online customer behavior.

Our experience analytics platform captures every in-page interaction and micro-gesture to understand the how and why of customer behavior. We turn this analysis into scores, visualizations and recommendations that make it easier for every team member to do the right thing.
